Subject: Vendor onboarding: request for legal name, remit & PO contacts

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. To get Cobalt set up in our vendor roster and route POs, we need a few items from your side so Procurement can create the master record cleanly. Can you please reply with the following details (or attach the completed onboarding form)?

- Legal entity name (exact as on tax docs)
- Tax ID (TIN / EIN) and type of tax document (W-9 or W-8)
- Registered address and mailing address (if different)
- Remit-to contact (name, email, phone) for invoice routing
- Purchase order contact (name, email, phone) for operational questions
- Preferred invoice delivery method (email to accounts@cobaltlogistics.com / portal / EDI)
- If you require a specific payment term or currency, note it here

Attached is our vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx to make this quick. If you can return the completed form and a signed W-9 (or W-8) by end of week, we can create the vendor record and route the first PO next week.

Thanks — feel free to loop in anyone from your finance team.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cobalt_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (excel, 32KB)

Priya / Marissa —

Reviewed Daniel's submission. A couple of quick checks before I push the record into the vendor master: 

1) Legal entity on the W-9 reads "Cobalt Logistics, Inc." which matches the form — good. Please confirm the address on the W-9 matches the registered address they provided (San Francisco addr).
2) Remit email is accounts@cobaltlogistics.com — can we confirm that this inbox accepts attachments and is not a portal-only address? If they prefer portal uploads we need a portal contact.
3) Payment terms Net 45 are fine for initial PO, but flagging to Finance that vendor requests Net 45 for approval (default is Net 30). Laura, want me to route an exception for Net 45 or should we ask them to accept Net 30 for the first 90 days?

If all good, I'll create the vendor record (entity ID: will be VND-2028-0345) and set default PO routing to daniel.ruiz@cobaltlogistics.com for operational queries and accounts@cobaltlogistics.com for invoicing.

Karthik
